mechanisms.name: Established-claim destination onboarding after public deployment
mechanisms.hypothesis: An existing economic claim may temporarily trade at different executable prices after a new destination deployment or pool becomes usable. Ordinary prefunded spot correction could earn a residual after restoring both token and cash inventories, but no such residual has been measured here.
mechanisms.economic_cause: Segmented inventory, newly forming depth and constrained transfer/market-making capacity, not an entitlement to favorable transaction ordering.
mechanisms.who_pays_and_earns: If a discrepancy exists, buyers/sellers face different prevailing market prices; an ordinary liquidity taker may receive the difference while paying LPs, chains and transfer providers. No pending user transaction is targeted or reordered.
mechanisms.recurrence_reason: Additional legitimate destination deployments may repeat onboarding friction. One historical launch episode does not establish repeatability, frequency or positive expected value.

novelty.potential_new_input: USDT0 on Stellar, officially announced 2026-09-02, is a recent non-EVM destination lead rather than a new arbitrage principle.

candidate_instrument.asset: USDT0, not every asset with ticker USDT or OMNI
chains_under_research: Ethereum and one source destination only if exact supported route is verified
protocols_under_research: ordinary eligible spot venue not yet identified
candidate_instrument.protocol_launch: January 2025 according to the release; particular Stellar deployment is younger

historical_comparator.asset: OmniCat OMNI, distinct from Omni Network
historical_comparator.loop: Base buy, Arbitrum sale from pre-held OMNI, later LayerZero rebalance.
historical_comparator.cex_listing: Seed reports MEXC 2023-12-28; exact primary event record was not found, and causality is not established.

required: Exact issuer/token/adapter identities and supported directional pathway.
Same underlying economic claim, accounting units and permissions on both chains.
Actual debit/credit after taxes, fees, precision conversion and dust.
A lawful available closing route, not a matching ticker or generic OFT/ITS label.
claim_equivalence.OFT_caveat: Direct versus adapter, peers, governance, message verification and token-specific restrictions matter. Modern protocol documentation does not prove historic OmniCat configuration.
claim_equivalence.ITS_caveat: If the representation uses ITS, verify interchainTokenId, metadata/scaling, per-chain manager and authority. No ITS pair was verified here.
claim_equivalence.USDT0_specific: Provider describes Ethereum lock/mint and burn/unlock; backing and cash redemption are distinct questions. IOTA's dedicated route shows universal direct mesh connectivity cannot be assumed.

financing_and_lifecycle: Use only publicly finalized market state after deployment; require ordinary spot and transfer availability before treating an event as eligible.
Pre-position a bounded source cash inventory, destination token inventory and gas balances; count all of them as committed capital.
Hypothetically buy the same claim at the cheaper ordinary spot venue and sell pre-held inventory at the dearer venue without front-running users.
Restore destination token inventory through the verified route after actual finality; restore source cash inventory through a separately eligible route.
Reconcile all assets, liabilities, fees, failed attempts and residual marks against passive inventory before any net-return claim.

access_and_capital.ordinary_entrant_access: Unverified; no privileged ordering, private flow or maker agreement assumed.
access_and_capital.borrowed_inventory: Not assumed. The seed's loan-backed replacement requires separate collateral and a complete repayment ledger.
access_and_capital.CEX_dependency: None required by the hypothesis; if price anchoring or execution requires one, identify it and apply the one-CEX limit.

costs_and_risks: Both spot fees, price impact, taxes, approval/gas costs and failed attempts.
Actual transfer quote, message/destination costs, delays, return-cash route and dust.
Inventory opportunity cost, directional residuals, bridge/issuer default, pauses and withdrawal restrictions.
Overlapping issuer/adapter/Ethereum lockbox failures can concentrate exposure across chains.
Incumbent capture, finite depth and disappearance before ordinary entrant execution.
cheap_falsifiers_if_later_authorized: Fail the particular route if exact asset/issuer or permissions do not match, no eligible sellable pool exists, or no available closing route exists.
Obtain synchronized size-specific public quotes and complete transfer estimates at a prespecified small size; fail the sampled route when proceeds cannot cover actual full-cycle costs.
Compare a complete inventory-neutral result with passive inventory; mark-to-market appreciation alone is not arbitrage.
For any CEX-causality claim, first resolve the exact listing/deposit/withdrawal event and define a comparison; otherwise keep causal attribution unknown.
mechanisms.charter_eligibility: Not established: verify age/TVL/audit, at most three chains/one CEX, overlapping 30% dependency limits, leverage and tail gates before any allocation. A new destination is not automatically a new underlying protocol, nor automatically eligible.

mechanisms.name: Existing-asset route expansion and inventory restoration
mechanisms.hypothesis: A newly available canonical transfer route might lower the cost of restoring existing spot inventory enough to change whether an already-public cross-chain correction is economical. It may instead eliminate discrepancies; no positive return is assumed.
mechanisms.economic_cause: The former transfer, settlement or available-inventory constraint changes after a new supported route, rather than a new asset automatically offering cheap value.
mechanisms.who_pays_and_earns: Any gross residual would come from ordinary market price differences; LPs, chains and issuer/transfer services collect their quoted charges. A lower transfer fee is a cost reduction, not itself trading revenue.
mechanisms.recurrence_reason: Further supported-route changes may alter restoration costs. Frequency and persistence are unknown.

novelty.potential_new_input: EURC support through Circle Gateway including Solana, announced 2026-10-23.
novelty.cross_workstream_overlap: Economics rail-convergence research; do not double-count as independent alpha.

candidate_instrument.asset: EURC on both sides, not EURC converted into USDC or cirBTC
protocols: eligible ordinary spot venues not yet identified

claim_equivalence.description: Gateway maintains balances per asset and transfers the same issuer asset. EURC is 6 decimals; cirBTC is a separate 8-decimal claim, not native BTC.
claim_equivalence.jurisdiction_and_redemption: Unverified; native issuer form does not imply unrestricted cash redemption or eligibility.
claim_equivalence.limits: EURC issuance on Stellar/Cronos does not imply Gateway support there. cirBTC is not supported on Solana, and Solana nanopayments are not supported.

financing_and_lifecycle: Start from identified, eligible existing EURC/quote-asset inventories on the selected two chains; count all gas and reserves.
Observe ordinary finalized spot prices; independently verify executable depth before considering any hypothetical correction.
For prefunded correction, restore the consumed inventory using the actual same-asset Gateway route and source-finality requirements.
Close or explicitly mark the quote-asset inventory imbalance, fees, delays and residual currency exposure.
Compare full cost and passive-inventory results with the prior restoration route; do not equate a fee saving with realized profit.

settlement_constraints.instant_access: Sub-500ms is the advertised post-finalization access, not initial capital availability or atomic trade execution.
settlement_constraints.ordinary_source_deposit: Provider table: Ethereum/Base approximately 13-19 minutes to attestation; no timing was measured in this pass.
settlement_constraints.withdrawal: Announcement gives a seven-day permissionless withdrawal delay; asset-specific docs confirm delayed withdrawal applies.
settlement_constraints.fee: Announcement advertises 1bp for EURC/cirBTC outside Arc, but transfer-specific estimate and token-unit gas are authoritative; actual all-in quote remains unknown.
settlement_constraints.premint: Staging balances are not user inventory, circulating supply or tradable pool depth.
settlement_constraints.operational_safety: No direct sends to a pre-mint account or Gateway Wallet; proper deposit methods are required. This pass submitted nothing.

access_and_capital.capital_efficiency: Post-finality mobility may change restoration time, not remove the cost of prefunded inventory or delayed emergency exit.
access_and_capital.CEX_dependency: None assumed; any later dependence must be explicit.

costs_and_risks: Both spot fees, price impact, transfer estimate, source/destination gas, return-cash inventory and failed attempts.
EUR/USD exposure and benchmark valuation if results are reported in dollars.
Issuer/freeze/custody, Gateway messaging and attestation, chain finality, outages and delayed withdrawal.
Common issuer/protocol/chain dependencies across supposedly separate inventories.
Asset-specific operator terms not resolved by generic or inconsistent marketing boilerplate.
cheap_falsifiers_if_later_authorized: First identify canonical token/mint and pools, verify ordinary sell/return permissions, and obtain an actual same-asset route estimate at stated size.
Reject the sampled route if completed-cycle proceeds fail to cover costs and capital lock, even if a single fee component fell.
Compare against old-route restoration and passive inventory; eliminate marks or FX drift mislabeled as arbitrage.
Reject the income hypothesis if ordinary entrants cannot act before the new route removes the discrepancy.
mechanisms.charter_eligibility: Protocol-specific age/TVL/audit, overlapping exposure limits, reserve custody and tail evidence remain unknown; older EURC issuance does not establish Gateway or route eligibility.
